home.subtitle: Clubs, events and everything you need for a night out in Barcelona: opening hours, prices, how to get there and what's open right now.
home.about_text: Noctua is the guide to Barcelona's nightlife: clubs, bars, events, festivals and everything you need when you're out (pharmacies, ATMs, night transport). You can browse without an account; with a free one you get the map, plan your nights and save favourites. Noctua uses Google Sign-In for quick, secure login: we only access your name and email to manage your account.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How Noctua collects, uses and protects your information.
privacy.s1_body: Noctua ("we", "our") is a nightlife discovery platform focused on Barcelona. We operate the website and app available at noctuaapp.com. For any privacy-related question, contact us at {email}.
privacy.s2_intro: We collect the following categories of data:
privacy.s2_items:
Account data::Email address, encrypted password, username, gender and year of birth. When you sign up we ask for your full date of birth only to check that you are over 18; we store the year only.
Profile photo::The image you voluntarily upload as your account avatar.
Usage data::Pages visited, clubs and events viewed, buttons clicked (for example tickets, directions or share), searches performed and how many results they returned, and where the visit came from (for example search engine, social network or invite link). They are linked to a random session identifier that disappears when you close the tab and, if you are logged in, to your account.
Favorites::Clubs, events and club nights you choose to save, along with the lists and personal notes you create to organize them.
Activity and points (XP)::If you mark that you'll attend an event or a club on a given night, check in at a club, or earn experience points, we store that activity (including the date) to show your progress and level within the app and to produce aggregated statistics.
Precise location (check-in only)::When you choose to check in on a club's page, we access your GPS location once to confirm you're near the venue. We don't store your coordinates — only which club and on which day you checked in.
Contact messages::Any message you send us through the Contact page, including requests to manage your club's or festival's listing.
Verified venue and festival accounts::If you're responsible for a club or festival and we grant you access to edit its listing, we link your account to that venue or event. Only you and the Noctua team can manage that listing from there.
In-app notifications::The notices we send you within Noctua (for example, confirmations or messages from the team) and whether you've read them.
Device data and analytics::Browser type, device type and approximate location (at country/city level) for usage analysis, via Vercel Analytics.
privacy.s3_intro: We use the data we collect to:
privacy.s3_items:
Provide and operate the Noctua platform.
Save and display your favorite clubs, events and club nights.
Calculate your progress and level within Noctua's points (XP) system.
Verify your location at the moment of check-in at a club (we never store it, only the result).
Respond to messages and support requests, including messages the Noctua team sends you directly.
Grant management access to verified venue or festival managers over their own listing, while Noctua's team always retains the ability to review, correct or revoke that access.
Improve the platform based on usage patterns.
Improve your searches and recommendations using your year of birth (for example, suggesting venues with an atmosphere suited to your age).
Produce aggregated, anonymous statistics about platform use and attendance at venues and events (for example age ranges, origin or timing of visits), which we may share with venues, event organizers and other third parties, including in exchange for payment.
Send important service communications (no marketing without your consent).
privacy.s4_body: We process your data under the following legal bases defined by the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR): performance of a contract (to provide the service you signed up for and personalize your searches), legitimate interest (to improve and protect the platform and to produce aggregated, anonymized statistics) and consent (for optional communications and access to your location when checking in). You can withdraw your consent or object to processing based on legitimate interest at any time.
privacy.s5_body: Your data is stored securely using Supabase, which offers professional-grade encryption both at rest and in transit. We do not sell or hand over your personal data to third parties. What we may share or sell are aggregated, anonymous statistics (for example, "60% of a venue's visitors are aged 25 to 34"). These statistics never identify individual people and groups of fewer than 5 people are not published. Access to personal data is restricted to authorized personnel only.
privacy.s6_body: We retain your account data for as long as your account remains active. If you delete your account, all associated personal data will be permanently deleted within 30 days. Contact messages are retained for up to 12 months for support purposes. Aggregated, anonymous statistics already produced contain no personal data and may be retained.
privacy.s7_intro: Under the GDPR, you have the right to:
privacy.s7_items:
Access the personal data we hold about you.
Request correction of inaccurate data.
Request deletion of your data ('right to be forgotten').
Object to or restrict the processing of your data.
Receive a copy of your data in a portable format.
File a complaint with your local data protection authority.
privacy.s7_closing: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at {email}.
privacy.s8_body: We use essential cookies necessary for authentication and session management, plus local browser storage (localStorage) to remember preferences such as which notices you've already read. We also use Vercel Analytics, an analytics tool that doesn't use tracking cookies or individually identify users, to understand in aggregate how the Platform is used. We don't use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. In addition, Noctua records its own usage analytics using a random session identifier stored in your browser's session storage (sessionStorage), which is deleted when you close the tab; it is not a cookie and does not follow you across sites. No third-party ad network has access to your data.
privacy.s9_intro: We work with the following providers to operate the Platform, each processing data only to the extent necessary to provide their service:
privacy.s9_items:
Supabase::Authentication, database and image storage. Processes data in accordance with the GDPR.
Vercel::Application hosting and aggregated, anonymous usage analytics.
Mapbox::Renders the maps within the app. When a map loads, Mapbox may receive your IP address and the technical information needed to display it.
Google Places::Source of public data (name, rating, reviews and photos) for clubs, festivals and essential services shown on their listings. We do not send your personal data to Google through this integration.
privacy.s9_closing: We do not share your personal data with any other third party unless required by law.
privacy.s10_intro: Noctua allows users to sign in with their Google account via Google OAuth 2.0. When you choose to sign in with Google, we receive the following information from Google:
privacy.s10_items:
Name::Your profile name registered with Google.
Email::Used to create and identify your Noctua account.
Profile photo::Optionally displayed on your Noctua profile.
privacy.s10_closing: We do not access your Google contacts, Google Drive, Gmail or any other Google service. Data received from Google is used solely to create and manage your Noctua account. You can revoke Noctua's access to your Google account at any time from your {googleSettings}.
privacy.s11_body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we'll update the date at the top of this page. Continued use of Noctua after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.s12_body: For any questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at {email}.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1_body: By accessing or using Noctua ("the Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you don't agree to these terms, please don't use the Platform. We reserve the right to update these terms at any time; continued use constitutes acceptance of any changes.
terms.s2_body: Noctua is a nightlife discovery platform offering information about clubs, events and nightlife, currently focused on Barcelona and progressively expanding to other areas of the Catalan coast. We are an informational platform — we do not operate venues, organize events or sell tickets directly. We may introduce additional features in the future, including paid features aimed at venues and organizers (for example, featured placement or listing statistics); if that happens, their specific terms will be communicated and accepted separately. We may offer venues, organizers and other third parties aggregated, anonymous statistics about use of the Platform and attendance at venues and events, without identifying specific individuals.
terms.s3_intro: By creating an account, you agree to:
terms.s3_items:
Provide accurate and complete information.
Keep your password secure and confidential.
Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.
Be responsible for all activity that occurs under your account.
terms.s3_closing: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account on Noctua, in line with the nature of nightlife content. When you sign up we ask for your date of birth to check this; registration by anyone under 18 is not permitted, and we may suspend or delete any account that does not meet this requirement.
terms.s4_items:
Use the Platform for unlawful purposes.
Extract, copy or reproduce content without permission.
Attempt unauthorized access to any part of the Platform.
Submit false, misleading or defamatory information.
Interfere with or disrupt the operation of the Platform.
Use the Platform to send unsolicited commercial communications.
Post notes, reports or other content that is offensive, illegal or infringes third-party rights; Noctua may remove it at any time.
terms.s5_intro: If you're responsible for a club or festival, after contacting us and verifying your identity we may link your account to the corresponding listing, giving you access to edit it directly. By using this access, you agree that:
terms.s5_items:
The information you publish (hours, prices, photos, nights or sessions) is accurate and up to date.
You only publish content you hold the necessary rights to.
Noctua may review, correct or remove content that breaches these Terms at any time.
Noctua reserves the right to revoke your management access to a listing at any time, for example if your relationship with the venue can no longer be verified.
terms.s6_body: We strive to keep all venue and event information accurate and up to date. However, we cannot guarantee the accuracy, completeness or currency of information on the Platform — including content published directly by verified venue or festival managers. Always verify details directly with the venue before attending. Each venue's entry policies (dress code, capacity, minimum age or other entry conditions) are the venue's sole responsibility; Noctua does not guarantee entry to any club, event or festival. A venue's live status (for example, "Lively" or "Packed") comes from the venue itself, from user check-ins or from estimates, and is indicative only.
terms.s7_body: All content on the Platform, including text, graphics, logos and design, is owned by Noctua or its content providers and is protected by applicable intellectual property laws. You may not reproduce, distribute or create derivative works without our express written permission.
terms.s8_body: The Platform may contain links to third-party websites, including venue websites and ticket-selling platforms. These links are provided for convenience only. We have no control over, and assume no responsibility for, the content or practices of such sites.
terms.s9_body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Noctua will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages arising from use of the Platform. Our total liability for any claim will not exceed the amount you paid for use of the Platform in the 12 months prior to the claim.
terms.s10_body: The Platform is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee that the Platform will be free of interruptions or errors.
terms.s11_body: Noctua offers an optional experience points (XP) and levels system that rewards certain in-app actions (marking attendance, checking in at a venue, usage streaks, etc.). XP points have no monetary value, are not transferable or redeemable for cash, and do not constitute a currency or financial product. We reserve the right to modify, reset or discontinue the points program, as well as adjust how points are awarded, at any time.
terms.s12_body: We reserve the right to suspend or cancel your account at our discretion if you breach these Terms of Service. You can delete your account at any time from your Profile page.
terms.s13_body: These Terms of Service are governed by the laws of Spain. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Barcelona, Spain.
terms.s14_body: For any questions about these Terms of Service, contact us at {email}.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Noctua.
faq.teamHelp: Our team will be happy to help.
faq.cat1_items:
What is Noctua?||Noctua is a nightlife discovery platform. It helps you find the best clubs, festivals and club nights, with verified information all in one place.
Is Noctua free to use?||Yes, Noctua is completely free for users. You can explore clubs, discover events and save your favorites at no cost.
Which cities does Noctua cover?||Right now we focus on Barcelona. We plan to progressively expand to other areas of the Catalan coast, starting with Sitges.
What languages is Noctua available in?||You can use the app in several languages from the language selector. Some dynamic content, such as Google reviews, is shown in Spanish.
faq.cat2_items:
Do I need an account to use Noctua?||You can explore clubs and events without creating an account. A free account also unlocks the map and Plan your night, and lets you save favorites, earn experience points (XP) and access personalized features.
How do I create an account?||Tap the profile icon or go to /signup. You need an email address, a password, a username, your gender and your date of birth (to check you are over 18), or you can sign up with your Google account.
How do I change my password?||Go to your Profile and tap Change password. You'll receive a link by email to reset it securely.
How do I delete my account?||You can request account deletion from your Profile page. All your data, including saved favorites, will be permanently deleted.
Do I need to be 18 to use Noctua?||Yes. Given the nature of the nightlife content, you must be at least 18 years old to create an account and use the app.
Why do you ask for my year of birth?||To check that you are over 18 and to improve your searches (for example, suggesting venues with an atmosphere suited to your age). From your date of birth we only store the year.
faq.cat3_items:
How do I save a club or event?||Tap the heart icon on any club, night or festival listing. You'll find everything saved in the menu (☰) › Favourites.
What does "Trending" mean?||Trending clubs are the ones generating the most interest in Barcelona's nightlife right now.
What does "Sold out" mean?||It means tickets or capacity for that event or club night are no longer available.
Can I buy tickets through Noctua?||Noctua doesn't sell tickets directly. When a club or festival has tickets available, we link you to their official website or ticketing platform.
What are check-ins and experience points (XP)?||You can check in when you are at the door of a club (we use your location once to verify it) to earn experience points and level up. It is an optional system with no monetary value.
What do «Lively», «Packed» and «Estimated» mean?||«Lively» and «Packed» show how a venue is right now, based on what the venue itself marks or on real check-ins from the last few hours. If there is not enough data, we show an estimate labelled «Estimated».
faq.cat4_items:
How do I get my club, bar or festival featured on Noctua?||Use our Contact page and choose "Suggest a venue" (for clubs and bars) or the corresponding partnership category for festivals. We review all submissions and will get back to you.
I'm responsible for a club or festival — can I manage my own listing?||Yes. Message us from Contact choosing "Manage my club or event". Once we verify you're responsible for it, we'll link your account and you'll be able to edit your listing, photos, prices and nights or sessions directly.
I've found incorrect information about a venue. How do I report it?||Use the Contact page and choose "Report incorrect information". Tell us the venue's name and what's wrong — we'll update it as soon as possible.
faq.cat5_items:
How does Noctua protect my data?||Your data is stored securely and we do not sell your personal data to third parties. We may share aggregated, anonymous statistics (for example, age ranges of a venue's visitors), which never identify individuals. You can find all the details in our Privacy Policy.
Who can I talk to if I have a problem?||Message us from the Contact page choosing "User support" and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

areas.genericBarrio: Clubs and nightclubs in {name}, Barcelona, with opening hours, prices, music style and how to get home afterwards.
areas.genericStyle: Venues in Barcelona that play {name}, with opening hours, prices, neighbourhood and directions.

intro.el-born: Narrow streets around Passeig del Born and Santa Maria del Mar, packed with cocktail bars and small venues. The place to start the night before heading to a club.
intro.el-raval: A diverse, alternative neighbourhood next to La Rambla: old-school bars, small venues and every kind of music, from rock to electronic.
intro.barri-gotic: The old town, with Plaça Reial as its meeting point: jazz and hip hop clubs, late-night bars and a very international crowd.
intro.eixample: A large central district with mid-size and big clubs, cocktail bars and the Gaixample, the city's LGBTQ+ nightlife area.
intro.gracia: A neighbourhood feel: busy squares, small bars and a few venues. More for drinks and a long night than for mega-clubs.
intro.poblenou: A former industrial district whose warehouses became big venues: home to much of Barcelona's best-known electronic music.
intro.poble-sec: Between Montjuïc and Paral·lel: historic concert halls, tapas bars and parties that range from indie to electronic.
intro.barceloneta: By the sea and the Port Olímpic, home to the best-known beach clubs. An international crowd and late closing times.
intro.port-olimpic: On the beachfront, with the city's biggest beach clubs, an international crowd and VIP tables.
intro.sarria-sant-gervasi: The uptown area: dressier clubs and cocktail bars around Tuset, Marià Cubí and Muntaner.
intro.sants-montjuic: Montjuïc and around: large spaces for parties and festivals, plus neighbourhood venues in Sants.
intro.techno: Clubs with techno sessions, from big rooms with powerful sound systems to small clubs where the booth sits right by the dancefloor.
intro.house: Venues where house rules: groove, vocals and long sets to dance without rushing.
intro.electronica: Electronic music in all its forms: techno, house, minimal and more, in big rooms and small clubs.
intro.reggaeton: Clubs playing reggaeton and Latin urban music, among the busiest in the city every weekend.
intro.comercial: Clubs playing commercial music: current hits, remixes and songs everyone sings along to.
intro.latina: Salsa, bachata, merengue and reggaeton: places to dance to Latin music in Barcelona.
intro.hip-hop: Hip hop, R&B, trap and urban music, in dedicated clubs and nights.
intro.rock-indie: Rock, indie, alternative pop and guitar classics, for those who prefer songs to the kick drum.
intro.jazz: Jazz, soul, funk and live music, often with a concert before the DJ set.

forVenues.f2Body: Say whether it's quiet, busy or queuing right now. It shows on your listing for 4 hours and then clears itself.
forVenues.f3Body: Post each night with its date, artist and price. Every night gets its own page, shown on your listing and visible to Google.
forVenues.f4Body: The main button on your listing goes straight to your ticketing page, with no steps in between.
forVenues.step1: Create your Noctua account and write to us through the form with the venue's name and your role.
forVenues.step2: We check you're the person in charge and link the listing to your Noctua account.
forVenues.step3: You open “My club” (or “My festival”) and edit it whenever you like.
forVenues.otherEssentialBody: Pharmacy, late-night food, supermarket or transport: ask us to add it to Essentials.
forVenues.otherMissingBody: Send us the name and address and we'll look into it.
forVenues.otherPartnerBody: Promotions, joint parties or any other idea.

clubNoctua.intro: Earn XP by going out: checking in at venues, completing challenges and using Noctua regularly, and level up. Perks marked “Coming soon” aren't active yet: for now you see your progress and badge.
clubNoctua.hoodsBody: Each check-in counts as a night in that neighbourhood. Three makes you a Regular; six, a Legend.
clubNoctua.perkBase: Favourites, night plans and check-in at every venue
clubNoctua.perkSoon_oro: Early access to tickets for limited-capacity events
clubNoctua.perkSoon_platino: Discounts at a selection of partner clubs
clubNoctua.perkSoon_zafiro: Invitations to VIP presales and giveaways
clubNoctua.perkSoon_elite: Exclusive perks for the most loyal members

invite.title: Invite a friend
invite.subtitle: You both earn XP.
invite.loginHint: Log in to get your invite link.
invite.error: Couldn't load your link. Try again in a moment.
invite.shareText: I'm planning my Barcelona nights with Noctua. Join with my link and we both earn XP:
invite.how1: Your friend opens your link and creates an account.
invite.how2: When they do their first check-in at a venue, you get +50 XP and they get +25 XP.
invite.howNote: The reward comes with the first check-in, not at sign-up, so only people who actually go out count.
